entities.name: Anna Kotočová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anna Kotočová is a Slovak former basketball player who competed for Czechoslovakia in the 1988 Summer Olympics, and 1992 Summer Olympics, and for Slovakia, in the 2000 Summer Olympics. She was inducted into the French Basketball Hall of Fame in 2021.
